bio.text: Bert Stedman has served in the Alaska Senate for District A (Southeast Alaska) since 2003.

His legislative biography describes him as a fourth-generation Alaskan raised in Petersburg and Sitka who ran an investment services firm for thirty years and spent over a decade in Sitka's local government.
It says he was Co-Chairman of the Senate Finance Committee from 2007 to 2012 and again from 2019, and chaired The Energy Council in 2012 and 2023.
